description: In the divisibility order on the divisors of 12, the upper bounds of {4,6} are exactly {12} and its lower bounds exactly {1,2}; these bounds do not belong to {4,6}.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor_pair_bounds :
  upperBounds {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯} =
      {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 12 ⋯} ∧
    lowerBounds {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯} =
        {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 1 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 2 ⋯} ∧
      Disjoint {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯}
        {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 1 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 2 ⋯,
          Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 12 ⋯}
